verdict.rationale: Rippling documents in-product pay-run comparison to catch discrepancies before approval, and general APIs for building custom apps. Nothing in the evidence shows an API endpoint for running a payroll preview, or any agent-driven anomaly surfacing through the API. The UI comparison feature and generic API building blocks are adjacent capabilities, not the API-driven preview this story requires.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent run a payroll preview via the API and surface anomalies for review before I approve the run
